_comment: Metadata fact-sheet round-trip ops for the metadata_vault_roundtrip differential. Templated on v4's metadata-vault-roundtrip.test.ts. Each op runs a patch through applyDocumentStoreWriteOverlay against a REAL character+vault (the charupd fixtures — reuse), then reads metadata.json back. Pins: whole-object REPLACE (not key-merge), null/empty -> {}, absent-key leaves the file untouched, and a replace overwrites an unparseable file without reading it first. Pepper matches build-characters-update-fixture.ts so the shared fixtures decrypt.
